title: fix(formula)!: a flow condition's record. / previous. read of a date field takes the date-text verdicts, so timestamp(record.DATE_FIELD) is refused as its bare name is
body:
Fixes #34662

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` already states the `date-text-call` rule (a `date` / `datetime` field handed to a timestamp-only call, and `timestamp()` over a `date` field) with `record.FIELD` spellings and names no site it is limited to, so it now holds for a flow condition's root reads as written

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：flow 条件（start / edge / `decision` 分支）里通过 `record.FIELD` / `previous.FIELD` 读日期字段时，现在与裸字段名一样接受 date-text 这一族校验；`timestamp(record.borrow_date) < now()`（`borrow_date` 为 date 字段）在 `os validate` 和 flow 发布门被拒，错误码、措辞、结果分支（`date-text-call-run-fails` 等）与裸名写法相同，提示改写为 `date(record.borrow_date)` 或 `isoDate(addDays(record.borrow_date, N))`。
- 为什么改：运行时 date 字段是 `YYYY-MM-DD` 文本，`timestamp()` 解析不了，这条 flow 每次运行都失败；裸名写法早已被拒，`record.` 写法却零告警通过。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING，按 minor 发布）：以前能通过 `os validate` 和发布的 flow 条件，若经 `record.` / `previous.` 把 date 字段交给 `timestamp()`（或交给 `isoDate()`、做文本日期运算），现在被拒，直到改写为 `date(record.FIELD)`；`registerFlow` 仍只记 advisory 日志、照常注册，已存的 flow 在下次发布前继续运行。datetime 字段、`date(...)` 改写、Timestamp 类型已判的形状（`record.due_date + 1`）不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（`recordRootDateTextIssue` 与 `typeSoundnessIssue` 的接入点）、`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`（`firstDateTextCall` / `firstDateTextVerdict` 新增的 `recordRootTypes` 参数与 `recordRootReadsFaultTimestampTyping`）、`.changeset/34662-flow-record-date-text.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts -t 34662`，预期 6 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（受管面未触及）；本 PR 是收窄，落地前需一次契约复审记录，由席位路由。

## What changes

A flow condition is evaluated over a scope where the run's row is bound twice: its fields flattened to bare names, and the row itself as `record` (with the row before the write as `previous`). The date-text family (`date-text-call*`, `date-text-arithmetic*`) typed the bare names only. Measured on `origin/main` fc5913e117 through `validateStackExpressions`, with the card's fixture (`library_loan`, `borrow_date: date`, `picked_up_at: datetime`, start `record-after-update`):

| start condition | findings before | findings after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `timestamp(record.borrow_date) < now()` | 0 | 1 error, `record.borrow_date` named |
| `timestamp(borrow_date) < now()` | 1 error | 1 error (unchanged) |
| `timestamp(previous.borrow_date) < now()` | 0 | 1 error, `previous.borrow_date` named |
| `timestamp(record.picked_up_at) < now()` (CONTROL) | 0 | 0 |

The same holds on an edge condition and on a `decision` branch. The other members of the family missed root reads the same way and are covered by the same change: `isoDate(record.picked_up_at) == '...'` (0 findings before; the bare `isoDate(picked_up_at)` was refused) and `record.due_date - record.borrow_date > duration('24h')` (no date-text finding before).

- `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`: `typeSoundnessIssue` runs a record-root pass after the bare-name date-text pass, at flattened scope only: `recordRootDateTextIssue`. It types `record.FIELD` / `previous.FIELD` with every field's type (a flow variable shadows a bare name, never a root member), leaves every bare name `dyn`, and keeps only `date-text-call*` / `date-text-arithmetic*`. This is the record-root pass `firstTypeMismatch` already runs for the text/boolean mismatch, applied to the date-text family. The outcome arm is the row's (`dateArm` with `bareNamesUnproven` false), as a root read keeps its outcome for `type-mismatch`. A shape the Timestamp typing of the roots already faults on (`record.due_date + 1`) belongs to the `date-arithmetic` family and stands down, the same order the flow value envelope uses. `dateTextIssue` / `dateTextCallIssue` take the optional root typing, and the message names the read as written (`verdict.root`).
- `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`: `firstDateTextVerdict` and `firstDateTextCall` take an optional `recordRootTypes` (flattened scope only) and pass it to `buildTypedEnv`. On that pass a root read qualifies by the root typing alone, so an `input.FIELD` read does not qualify. Without the argument every call is unchanged. `DateTextVerdict` gains the optional `root`. `recordRootReadsFaultTimestampTyping` is the stand-down probe. None of these is on the package's public entry.
- `.changeset/34662-flow-record-date-text.md`: `minor` for `@objectstack/formula` (the kind `narrowed` takes at least `minor`), with the declaration lines, the **BREAKING** banner, a FROM to TO table and the ADR-0087 disposition `already-registered` naming the three semantic entries (`formula-timestamp-date-only-refused`, `formula-date-text-call-refused`, `formula-date-subtraction-refused`). Their `surface` text already names flow conditions among the predicates judged with field types, spelled with `record.FIELD`, so it is left as is: this change makes that text true for a root read. No entry, generated file or registry changes.

No producer change was needed outside `packages/formula`. `@objectstack/lint` (`os validate`, and the runtime publish gate that runs the same `runStackExpressionPasses` body) and `@objectstack/service-automation` (`registerFlow`) already hand flow conditions the flattened hint with field types and the declared outcome. The fix reaches all three through the shared validator.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/validate-date-text-arithmetic.test.ts`: new top-level describe in the date-text harness. `record.` and `previous.` over a date field are refused under `date-text-call-run-fails` with full params (call, reference, rewrite, shift), and the evaluator faults on them over the run's scope. CONTROL: `datetime` and the prescribed `date(...)` parse are clean and evaluate to `true`. Arm pins: `run-may-fail` with no declared outcome; `run-fails` kept on a root read when bare names are unproven. A flow variable shadowing the bare name leaves the root read judged. `isoDate(record.picked_up_at)` and root-read date-text arithmetic are refused. The stand-downs (`record.due_date + 1`, an `input.` read) take no date-text code.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`: new top-level describe. Start, edge and `decision` conditions refuse `record.` / `previous.` at the bare name's path and severity, with the shift text. Rule id `expression-invalid` through `runAuthoringRules('build', ...)`. CONTROL: `datetime` stays clean through either root at all three sites.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-flow-condition-record-date-text.test.ts` (new; the flow publish door, `saveMetaItem` then `publishMetaItem` over the real engine): the bare name, `record.` and `previous.` are each refused with `{ code: 'INVALID_METADATA', status: 422 }`, one `expression-invalid` date-text issue each, and the item left `draft`. CONTROL: `datetime` through either root publishes (`active`).
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-schema-e2e.test.ts`: new describe. `registerFlow` logs the date-text advisory for `record.` / `previous.` as for the bare name and registers the flow. CONTROL: `datetime` is not advised.

Ablation, after the fix was committed (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`, trap restore): the record-root pass was disabled in `validate.ts` (call guarded by a literal that never equals the source), `@objectstack/formula` rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirmed the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`. Result: formula 4 failed / 83 passed, lint 4 failed / 1 passed, service-automation 1 failed / 4 passed, runtime 1 failed / 1 passed. Every refusal pin went red and every CONTROL stayed green. Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean, `git status --porcelain` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Declaration (seat ruling, L1 REWORK round 1).** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: a pure narrowing, since the new `recordRootTypes` parameter is on non-exported functions and nothing published widens. A contract-review-tier L2 review is owed before the queue; the seat routes it.
- **The publish door for a flow condition is `publishMetaItem` (seat: accepted as landed).** `registerFlow` logs a condition's schema-aware findings as an advisory and never throws, by contract (#1928, `flow-registration-checks.ts`); it does not refuse the bare spelling either. The refusal with `code` / `status` is the metadata publish gate (`INVALID_METADATA` / 422), pinned in `packages/runtime`; `registerFlow` is pinned for advisory parity.
- **Test placement.** The dispatch asked for a new test file named after the card. AGENTS.md (ruling record 6583487846) puts a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness into that file as a top-level `describe`. So the formula, lint and `registerFlow` pins went into their existing harnesses. The publish-door pin is a new file, because no harness pins a flow condition's date verdict at that door.
- The `record` root is typed even when a flow declares a variable named `record`. The `type-mismatch` record-root pass has always done the same, and this change does not alter it.
- Same-shape gap outside this family, not fixed here: the `date-arithmetic` verdict (Timestamp typing, `due_date + 1 > 5`) refuses the bare name in a flow condition but not `record.due_date + 1 > 5` / `previous.due_date + 1 > 5`. Measured on this branch with a `required` date field: 1 error and 0 / 0 findings. The seat files it; this family stands down on that shape so as not to change its code.

## Verification

Final head 60d4e1c6c7. Dogfood battery on it (the `(narrowing)` arm): `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 479 passed / 3 skipped (482), Tests 4072 passed / 68 skipped (4140). Merged-head (653f1fb45e) package tests and typechecks: formula 68 files / 1878 tests, lint `validate-expressions.test.ts` 505/505, service-automation e2e 5/5, runtime publish-door 2/2, all four typechecks green. Gate readings and CI: the os-dev-report comments on the card.

<details><summary>Premise table on origin/main fc5913e117 (built lint dist)</summary>

```
[start] timestamp(record.borrow_date) LT now() -> 0
[start] timestamp(borrow_date) LT now() -> 1 (error, `borrow_date` is a date field ...)
[start] timestamp(record.picked_up_at) LT now() -> 0
[start] timestamp(previous.borrow_date) LT now() -> 0
[edge]  same three rows: 0 / 1 / 0
```
(LT spells the less-than operator.)
</details>

<details><summary>After the fix (same probe)</summary>

```
[start] timestamp(record.borrow_date) LT now() -> 1 error, `record.borrow_date` is a date field
[start] timestamp(borrow_date) LT now() -> 1 error
[start] timestamp(record.picked_up_at) LT now() -> 0
[start] timestamp(previous.borrow_date) LT now() -> 1 error, `previous.borrow_date` is a date field
[start] timestamp(previous.picked_up_at) LT now() -> 0
[edge]  identical
```
</details>
